def ycells(frame):
    out=[]
    for n in frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='Y' and n['pixels']==4:
            r=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; c=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            out.append((min(r),min(c)))
    return sorted(out)
